title: Renewable resources
competency: Distinguish between renewable and non-renewable natural resources.

keywords.def: All material available in the environment that people use.
Resources that can replace themselves naturally after use.

en.text: By renewability, natural resources are renewable or non-renewable. Renewable resources replace themselves naturally after use. A forest can give timber year after year if it is carefully managed. Examples are air, water, sunlight, wind and forest.

screens.title: Will the wind run out?
screens.ask: Ethiopia uses the wind at Adama to make electricity. Will the wind ever run out?
screens.after: Wind is renewed by nature again and again. Resources like this are called renewable.

screens.title: 3.3 Types of natural resources
paras: By renewability, natural resources are grouped into two types.
They are renewable and non-renewable resources.

screens.title: 3.3.1 Renewable resources
paras: Resources that replace themselves naturally after use are called renewable resources.
A forest can produce timber year after year, if it is carefully and scientifically managed.
Examples: air, water, sunlight, wind, forest.

screens.title: Renewable examples
items: We breathe it every day; nature keeps renewing it.
Rain refills rivers, lakes and springs.
The sun shines again every day.
Wind turbines can use it again and again.
Trees regrow if they are managed carefully.

screens.title: Key words
defs: All material available in the environment that people use.

screens.why: Sunlight comes back every day. Coal and oil are non-renewable.
screens.clue: Which one comes back by itself?

screens.text: Forest and water resources are non-renewable resources.
screens.why: Forest and water are renewable. They can replace themselves.
screens.clue: Look at the list of renewable examples.

screens.why: Air, water, wind and forest renew themselves. Natural gas does not.
screens.clue: Which one is a fossil fuel?

screens.text: A forest is renewable. When could it still be used up?
opts: When trees are cut faster than they regrow, without careful management
Never, forests cannot be used up
screens.ans: When trees are cut faster than they regrow, without careful management
screens.why: The book says a forest gives timber year after year only if it is carefully and scientifically managed. Over-cutting destroys it.
screens.clue: Read the condition the book gives for a forest.

test.text: Resources that replace themselves naturally after use are called:

test.why: Wind comes back again and again.

test.text: A forest gives timber year after year if it is:
Which statement about renewable resources is correct?
opts: They can be used more than once and replace themselves
They exist only in limited supply
They can be used only one time
test.ans: They can be used more than once and replace themselves
test.why: Limited supply and one-time use describe non-renewable resources.
